text: dsh-plugin-brand-custom 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的品牌外观插件，可自定义侧边栏品牌图标与名称，并替换会话页的品牌标记和浏览器 favicon。它通过品牌展示槽提供图标和名称，在插件详情页加入设置卡片，让用户编辑名称、选择图片、预览、保存或恢复默认值；配置变化会更新相关展示。适合希望为 DSH Web 调整界面品牌形象的用户。默认图标随客户端包提供，无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-brand-custom customizes DSH Web branding. It replaces the sidebar name and icon, conversation page mark, and browser favicon. A settings card lets users edit the name, choose and preview an image, save changes, or restore defaults. A bundled icon is provided.
想把 DSH Web 侧边栏的品牌图标和名称换成自己的。
能在插件设置里改会话页显示的品牌标志吗？
I want to change the branding and favicon shown by my DSH web interface.
dsh-plugin-brand-custom 的功能「替换品牌展示」：将自定义图标和名称显示在 DSH Web 侧边栏及会话页品牌槽，并同步替换浏览器 favicon。
dsh-plugin-brand-custom 的功能「品牌设置卡片」：在插件详情页编辑品牌名称并选择图片预览，保存或重置设置；图标文件须为图片且不超过 256KB。

dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · dsh-plugin-brand-custom：Custom brand icon and name for the DeepSeek Harness Web client — replaces the sidebar brand mark/name and the conversation hero mark, with a settings card to change them live, no rebuild and no reload.

dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · What it does：- Occupies the `sidebar.brand.mark`, `sidebar.brand.name`, and `conversation.hero.brand.mark` slots with a custom icon and name, and swaps the browser favicon to match.
- **Settings card on the plugin's detail page** (Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom): edit the brand name, pick an icon image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/SVG, up to 256KB, previewed in place), and save — the sidebar, hero, and favicon update immediately. Reset restores the bundled defaults.
- Values persist in the profile's settings document, so every browser and every restart sees the same brand.
- Disables the official brand occupants (`ui-brand-official`), which only register in `official` builds; single brand slots are exclusive.
- Ships a bundled default icon from `src/client/assets/icon.png`, inlined as a base64 data URL by the tsdown build.
dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · What it does：Requires dsh 0.1.7 or newer (the host serves the plugin's settings from its own Config schema there).

dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-brand-custom
```

Or from the [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) plugin market inside the GUI: search "brand-custom", one click.

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Plugins → dsh-plugin-brand-custom** (click the card title) to reach the settings card.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-brand-custom`.

dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · Develop：```sh
npm install --legacy-peer-deps   # type packages track the @deepseek-ai next channel
npm run bundle                   # tsc (lib/types) → tsdown (lib/client.js, PNG inlined as data URL)
```

dsh-plugin-brand-custom README · Develop：`lib/client.js` is a closure-factory bundle (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load`): the baseline modules (React, Cordis, ui-slots, ui-primitives) stay external and resolve through the shell's shared module table; everything else inlines. Those contracts are provided by the host shell at runtime, so the only runtime dependency is `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (declared as a peer, supplied by the host profile).
